Swipe · captured 11 August 2026 · F133

Acquisition.com — the Scaling Workshop funnel

Alex and Leila Hormozi sell a $5,000 seat at a 2-day workshop at their Las Vegas HQ. There is no webinar, no VSL funnel and no paid acquisition to speak of. The whole machine is: give away four full courses and a 1.4M-copy book, mail the list every two days forever on an exact 56-day loop, then route everyone into an application for something they cannot have — becoming a portfolio company — and sell the workshop as the consolation prize for failing it. Will is inside this funnel himself: he bought the book in Aug 2025 and has booked their call twice.

IF revenue / EBITDA is too small

Q14 fires: “Based on your answers, you’d need to grow in order to qualify as a portfolio company… and we’d like to help. Would you like us to show you exactly what we’d do to scale your company? SELF-DISQUALIFICATION, on the sales page

“If you are under 250k/yr this is not a fit (yet.)” and “If you haven’t made at least $5k from the free content, don’t do it.” They print the floor in the FAQ so the setter never has to argue it, and it doubles as a flex: the free stuff is worth $5k on its own.
